name: reacto-form-inputs
description: Example React components that implement the Composable Form Specification for form inputs
author: Dairy State Designs (http://dairystatedesigns.com/)

scripts.build: rm -fr dist/* && tsc -p tsconfig-build.json && esbuild src/*.ts src/*.tsx src/shared/*.ts --outbase=src --outdir=dist/esm --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2022 && esbuild src/*.ts src/*.tsx src/shared/*.ts --outbase=src --outdir=dist/cjs --format=cjs --platform=browser --target=es2015 && ./scripts/post-build.sh
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build

browserslist: > 0.5%, last 2 versions, Firefox ESR, not dead

plugins.successComment:
